description: Linux window identities used by the execution-entry guard (detection-rules.md §4) and the paste guard allowlist (§5.3), same layout as windows.json. The platform layer passes the X11 WM_CLASS class (or the Wayland app_id) as `class` and /proc/<pid>/comm as `process`; on Wayland there is no pid, so the app_id is passed as both. Classes and processes compare case-insensitively; comm names are cut to 15 bytes by the kernel (gnome-terminal-server is `gnome-terminal-`). Linux has no Run dialog and no FileFix-style file manager address bar, so dialog_class and shell_process are sentinels that never match a real window and the dialog / explorer lists are empty. Measured in OrbStack (Alpine edge): XTerm/xterm under Xvfb + openbox, foot under sway 1.12; the others come from each project's desktop file / source and still need checking. allowed_window_classes are compared exactly.
